The 🗿 Decade Awards

@isleoffilms and I are here to present a set of awards dedicated to what film had to offer this entire decade.
For the next several days, a new category will be posted to either mine or @isleoffilms account for everyone to vote on what they believe is the best in each category.
Just a heads-up: we and an entire group of people helped organize these nominees for countless hours so if you don’t see a particular nominee that you feel should’ve been nominated, we apologize.

All that being said, our second category is for Best Sound Design, and here are the nominees:

Whiplash
Blade Runner 2049
Dunkirk
Roma
Baby Driver
Mad Max: Fury Road
Inception
Arrival
Mother!
Good Time

You can vote by liking the comment of your choice below! 🎥
